text:
Grace (AR): Heads up — Gartner asked to move the analyst briefing to Thu 10:00 AM PT and requested a 48h extension on the embargo. They also want to review the benchmark numbers and sign off on one quote from Michael.

Tara (Comms): If we give 48h that shifts publish out. Is there wiggle room? @Michael - can you sign off on a short quote and fill the fact-check doc by EOD?

Michael - Product: I can draft a quote. Which metrics are they vetting — p50/p95 latency or per-token cost?

Grace (AR): They flagged per-token unit cost reduction vs baseline and p95 tail latency. Fact-check doc: https://redwood.com/briefings/benchmarks (internal) — I just uploaded artifacts.

Lauren (Legal): We can approve a 48h extension but want embargo locked to Fri 9:00 AM PT at latest. Need final quote language in a doc we can redline by 5:00 PM today.

Jamal (PressAgency): Recommend phrasing like 'independent benchmarks show ~30% lower per-token inference cost' — but we need an exact defensible number and attribution. Marketing/legal should sign off.

Michael - Product: I suggest: 'In our tests, the Redwood runtime reduced per-token inference costs by ~28% compared to the baseline configuration.' I don't want to use 'independent' unless a third party ran the full experiment.

Tara (Comms): Agree — avoid 'independent' for now. Grace, can you confirm who executed the runs? @Jamal please don't push 'independent' yet.

Grace (AR): Asked Gartner — they said they performed internal reproducibility checks on our artifacts (not a fully third-party end-to-end run). Possible compromise: 'Gartner ran reproducibility checks on provided artifacts.'

Lauren (Legal): That's more factual. Legal is okay with: 'Gartner ran reproducibility checks on the provided artifacts.' No superlatives.

calendar-bot: Event updated: Analyst briefing moved to Thu 10:00 AM PT; invites resent.

Jamal (PressAgency): I will update the embargo request to ask for Fri 9:00 AM PT publish and note that Gartner completed reproducibility checks. Need final quote copy by tomorrow 6:00 PM PT to meet their timeline.

Michael - Product: I've added the quote to the fact-check doc and annotated where the cost numbers come from: https://redwood.com/briefings/benchmarks#quotes — please review.

Tara (Comms): :thumbsup: I'll coordinate the press list and confirm the embargo extension with our priority outlets once Legal approves the final language.

Grace (AR): Quick recap/owners: Lauren to approve quote language (EOD), Michael posts final quote (by 6pm PT), Jamal updates embargo to Fri 9am PT, Tara coordinates publish timing and outlets. Ping if anything slips.
